'''Jeremos''' was an independent [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] sanitation engineer who operated from a [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] headquarters and took contracts to work on [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]. She was noted in her field and had many different employers over her career.

==Biography==
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], in the months after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]],<ref name="CSWE II 157">{{CSWECite|II|156}}</ref> Jeremos was hired by the captain of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Indomitable (Imperial I-class)|''Indomitable'']], which could not join the rest of the Imperial fleet due to maintenance problems. Jeremos was tasked with scouring the ship's waste bays. In need of some brute strength to lend a hand, the Squib put out a call for workers. After haggling over the pay involved (Jeremos wanted to pay as little as possible), she hired a group of laborers who, unbeknownst to her, were agents of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Jeremos took them up in her personal shuttle to board the Imperial craft, where they worked more or less independently.<ref name="RESB" />

Once on board, the Rebels tried to undermine the ''Indomitable'' and further the Alliance agenda. The job was not as smooth as they had hoped, however, as the garbage bays were infested with [[Dianoga/Legends|dianogas]] and [[trash bat]]s. One compactor even housed a malfunctioning [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] that fired on anything within its line of sight. Despite the inherent danger, Jeremos insisted on carrying the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] out of the ship and salvaging it.<ref name="RESB" />

==Personality and traits==
Jeremos did her job with equipment such as a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], [[Medpac/Legends|medpack]], [[Survival kit/Legends|survival kit]], and [[metric spanner]]; she kept this all in her backpack. She owned and operated a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], for which she still owed five payments in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="RESB" />

She was something of a cheapskate and wanted to maximize her profit by hiring help at the lowest wage possible.<ref name="RESB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jeremos appears in a sidebar of the ''Rebellion Era Sourcebook'' from [[Wizards of the Coast]] ([[2001]]). The segment details an idea for an adventure for gamemasters running a Rebel Alliance campaign. The accompanying material discusses the waste disposal procedures of the Galactic Empire and is inspired by the scene in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] when [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] hides the ''Millennium Falcon'' among the debris of a star destroyer's garbage.<ref name="RESB" />
